setlist.title: And We Bid You Good Night

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (3 reviews): The Dark Star medley is the standout of the show, with Phil especially prominent; Dark Star reaches its climax suddenly, seemingly from nowhere [7][10][12]
- **Alligator** (1 review, 1 other source): Jerry asks the crowd for requests; one man shouts for Alligator and Phil launches in heavily; Bobby again noodles Weather Report Prelude chords just before Alligator [1][10]
- **Mountains Of The Moon** (1 review): Mountains of the Moon flowing into Dark Star creates a hushed mood [8]
- **Hard To Handle** (1 review): Jerry's pedal steel playing on Hard To Handle is a highlight [9]
- **Cosmic Charlie** (1 review): Jerry's pedal steel playing on Cosmic Charlie also stands out [9]
- **The Other One** (1 review): The Other One into The Eleven is loud and powerful enough to shake walls [7]
- **Cryptical Envelopment** (1 other source): Bobby noodles Weather Report Prelude chords just before Cryptical Envelopment [1]
- **The Eleven** (1 review): First Eleven stops after the William Tell intro, then jumps abruptly into Lovelight; The Eleven's instrumental section returns much later in the set [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **Mountains Of The Moon**: rare: 14 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **gd69-04-05.sbd.miller.18701.sbesok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 130 min; rated 4.57/5 by 53 [1]. Said about its sound: Slight hiss makes the reviewer doubt the lineage is as pure as claimed, though it comes from Charlie Miller; Recording quality is clean [7][14]
- **gd1969-04-05.136650.sbd.reelmaster.dat.sirmick.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 134 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1969-04-05.sbd.squirlin.65.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 131 min; rated 3.5/5 by 8 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer had heard these were the final Avalon Ballroom shows [6]
- Eclipsed by the Fillmore run from late February to early March, but equally strong [4]
- Presents the Dead at their fully psychedelic 1969 stage, before their shift toward country later that year [4]
- Mountains of the Moon and Dark Star are nice but not among the band's best versions [8]
- Reviewer ranks 1969 peaks as three runs, the first being the late February to early March Fillmore shows [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-04-05.sbd.miller.18701.sbesok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [1]
- **gd1969-04-05.136650.sbd.reelmaster.dat.sirmick.flac16**: taped by Anonomous; transferred by SIRMick; source: Source: Soundboard > Reel Master > Dat (48k) [2]
- **gd1969-04-05.sbd.squirlin.65.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by squirlin; source: SBD > REEL > REEL > DAT > SP/DIF > HD > SHN [3]
